title: Leyline terrain delta (<name>.terrain.json), version 1
description: One map tile's changes from its base, as numbers and file names only: never a byte of a game file. Shape from docs/NOGGIT-DEN-PLAN.md section 2.5; meaning of each field in forge/docs/DEN-MODE.md. Written by Forge (GPL-3.0) on save and by the MIT leyline-terrain crate; both only share this file format. Readers are strict, never run anything from it, and refuse files over 4 MB.

base.description: What the delta applies to: own:<map>/<tile x>/<tile y> (the tile from the player's own game files), pack:<name> (a pack's land moved onto the Den's tile), or blank.

open.description: Chunk indices (0-255, row * 16 + column, the map file's chunk order) that may differ from the base. Every entry of chunks is in this list.

pad.description: The Den's starting pad, when it has one: its floor height in yards and its texture's path in the game.

chunks.description: Each changed chunk's whole state. A chunk that is the same as the base is not listed.

models.description: Ground models (M2 and WMO placements) on the tile that are not in the base unchanged: new ones, and base ones that moved (same uid).

game_path.description: A file's path inside the player's own game archives (a name, never its bytes).

heights.description: 145 little-endian 32-bit floats (580 bytes), absolute heights in yards, in the map file's vertex order (9 outer, 8 inner, alternating rows).

normals.description: Always false in version 1: readers compute normals from the heights.

layers.description: Texture layers, bottom first (at most 4). Layer 0 has no alpha; each other layer has its 64 x 64 alpha map.

alpha.description: 4096 bytes, one 0-255 value per cell, 64 rows of 64.

holes.description: The chunk's 16-bit hole mask (4 x 4 cells).

water.description: The chunk's first liquid layer; no key means no water.

type.description: The liquid type id (the game's own LiquidType row).

mask.description: 8 bytes, little-endian 64-bit mask of the 8 x 8 cells that have water.

colors.description: Vertex colours: 145 x 4 bytes (580 bytes) as the map file stores them: blue, green, red, alpha; 127 is 1.0. No key means none.

path.description: The .m2 (or .mdx) or .wmo path in the player's own game.

uid.description: The placement's unique id. New ground models use 2130706432 (0x7F000000) and up; a base model's own uid means it moved.

x.description: World yards from the Den's middle, along the world's x axis.

y.description: World yards from the Den's middle, along the world's y axis.

z.description: Yards above the Den's middle height.

rx.description: Rotation in degrees, the map file's first rotation value.

ry.description: Rotation in degrees, the map file's second rotation value.

rz.description: Rotation in degrees, the map file's third rotation value.

scale.description: 1.0 is normal size; WMOs are always 1.0.
